title: 昂船洲大橋~Stonecutters Bridge
focus: 颱風區千米跨斜張橋：分離雙箱梁氣動、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與混凝土背跨的整合~A typhoon-zone 1 km cable-stayed span: split twin-box aerodynamics, composite stainless monopole towers and concrete back spans
summary: 昂船洲大橋以 1,018 m 主跨橫越香港藍巴勒海峽，主跨為中央開槽的流線形雙鋼箱梁，背跨為預力混凝土雙箱梁，兩座單柱塔下段為混凝土、上段為雙相不鏽鋼外皮的鋼—混凝土複合結構。本課從颱風風荷載、塔梁液壓緩衝器、224 根斜拉索、鋼箱梁吊裝與鋼混接頭，一路到雷諾數效應的風洞試驗、跨中撓度監測與長索維護。~Stonecutters Bridge crosses Hong Kong’s Rambler Channel with a 1,018 m main span of streamlined twin steel boxes separated by a central gap, prestressed concrete twin-box back spans and two monopole towers whose lower parts are concrete and upper parts steel–concrete composite with a duplex stainless skin. The course runs from typhoon wind load, tower–deck hydraulic buffers, the 224 stays, deck-segment lifting and the steel–concrete junction to Reynolds-number effects in wind testing, mid-span deflection monitoring and long-stay maintenance.

units.anchor: 中央開槽雙箱梁~Split twin-box deck
units.title: 颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁~Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋位於葵青貨櫃碼頭入口，颱風季的強風紊流度高，主跨 1,018 m 的橋面又輕又柔，風力同時造成橫向彎曲、扭轉與可能的顫振。設計者把約 53 m 寬的橋面分成兩個流線形鋼箱梁，中間留空並以橫梁連接：開槽讓上下表面的壓力差得以洩放，提高扭轉顫振的臨界風速，並降低渦流鎖定的振幅。公開設計資料顯示，零攻角無車時顫振臨界風速約 95 m/s，但攻角變為 ±5° 時降到約 50 m/s，說明颱風紊流造成的攻角變化才是控制因素。~Stonecutters Bridge sits at the entrance to the Kwai Tsing container terminals, where typhoon winds are highly turbulent, and the 1,018 m main-span deck is light and flexible, so wind causes lateral bending, torsion and potentially flutter. The designers split the roughly 53 m deck into two streamlined steel boxes with an open gap between them, linked by cross girders: the gap vents the pressure difference between upper and lower surfaces, raising the torsional flutter speed and reducing vortex lock-in amplitudes. Published design data show a flutter speed of about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic, falling to about 50 m/s at ±5°, so the angle-of-attack changes caused by typhoon turbulence govern.
units.model: 橋面橫向風力 w = ½ρU²·C_D·D。取 ρ = 1.225 kg/m³、U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8（以箱高為參考）、D = 4 m：q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa，w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m，作用於 1,018 m 主跨合計約 5.0 MN；風速降為 40 m/s 時 w ≈ 3.1 kN/m，與 U² 成正比。係數與箱高為教學假設。~Lateral wind load on the deck w = ½ρU²·C_D·D. With ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8 referenced to box depth and D = 4 m, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa and w = 1,531×0.8×4 ≈ 4.9 kN/m, about 5.0 MN over the 1,018 m main span; at 40 m/s w ≈ 3.1 kN/m, scaling with U². Coefficient and depth are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以風洞斷面模型量測不同攻角下的阻力、升力與扭矩係數，並做顫振導數識別；把颱風紊流的攻角分布代入顫振分析，確認在最不利攻角下的臨界風速仍高於設計要求，再以全橋分析計算跨中側向撓度與塔底彎矩。~Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients at several angles of attack on section models and identify flutter derivatives; feed the typhoon turbulence distribution of incidence into the flutter analysis to confirm that the critical speed at the worst angle still exceeds the requirement, then compute mid-span lateral deflection and tower-base moments globally.
units.failure: 若只以零攻角的試驗結果判定顫振安全，強紊流下的實際攻角可能使臨界風速降低近一半；開槽寬度或橫梁形狀在細部設計中被修改而未重新試驗，也可能出現未預期的渦振或扭轉不穩定。~Judging flutter safety only from zero-incidence results can overlook that real angles of attack in strong turbulence nearly halve the critical speed; altering the gap width or cross-girder shape in detailed design without retesting can introduce unexpected vortex vibration or torsional instability.
units.misconception: 橋面越寬越重，風就越吹不動，所以千米跨只要加重即可抗颱風。~A wider, heavier deck is always harder for wind to move, so a 1 km span only needs more weight to resist typhoons.
units.practice: 風工程報告應明列各攻角的顫振臨界風速、有無交通的差異與試驗模型所含的附屬物；任何欄杆、防撞護欄或檢修軌道的形狀變更都要回到風工程顧問複核。~The wind report should tabulate flutter speeds by angle of attack, with and without traffic, and list the attachments modelled; any change to railings, barriers or inspection rails goes back to the wind consultant for review.

units.anchor: 塔–梁液壓緩衝器~Tower–deck hydraulic buffers
units.title: 混凝土背跨壓重與塔梁縱向連接~Concrete back-span ballast and the tower–deck connection
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋兩側背跨各長 289 m，由 79.75、70、70、69.25 m 四跨預力混凝土雙箱梁組成，混凝土的重量提供平衡主跨鋼梁的壓重，密布的背跨橋墩則讓背索錨固點接近固定，提高整體勁度。主跨與背跨連成連續橋面，溫度造成的伸縮必須能自由發生；但颱風陣風、地震與煞車屬於快速荷載，橋面不能任意滑動。因此塔與梁之間在橋面高程設置液壓緩衝器：慢速溫度位移時油可通過孔道，幾乎不產生力；快速荷載時閥門鎖住，緩衝器像剛性連桿把縱向力傳給橋塔。~Each back span of Stonecutters Bridge is 289 m long, made of four prestressed concrete twin-box spans of 79.75, 70, 70 and 69.25 m; the concrete weight ballasts the steel main span, and the closely spaced back-span piers make the back-stay anchor points nearly fixed, raising global stiffness. The main and back spans form a continuous deck whose thermal expansion must occur freely, but typhoon gusts, earthquakes and braking are fast loads under which the deck must not slide. Hydraulic buffers between tower and deck at deck level therefore let oil pass through orifices during slow thermal movement, producing almost no force, and lock under fast loads so the buffer acts as a rigid link carrying longitudinal force to the tower.
units.model: 溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、L = 560 m、ΔT = 40 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.269 m。若這 40 °C 在 6 小時內發生，平均速度 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s，遠低於陣風下橋面約 0.1 m/s 的擺動速度，緩衝器可據此區分兩種荷載。背跨與主跨長度比 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。~Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 560 m and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.269 m. If the 40 °C change occurs over 6 hours, the mean velocity is 0.269/21,600 ≈ 1.2×10⁻⁵ m/s, far below the roughly 0.1 m/s deck motion in gusts, so the buffer can distinguish the two. The back-to-main span ratio is 289/1,018 ≈ 0.28. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 緩衝器出廠以低速蠕動試驗確認溫度位移下的阻力上限，以高速試驗確認鎖定力與鎖定位移；安裝後量測不同季節的塔梁相對位移與溫度回歸，並在颱風事件後檢視紀錄，確認鎖定行為與設計一致。~Factory-test the buffers at creep speeds to confirm the resistance limit under thermal movement, and at high speed to confirm lock-up force and lock-up displacement; after installation regress tower–deck relative displacement against temperature across seasons and review records after each typhoon to confirm lock-up as designed.
units.failure: 若緩衝器密封漏油或閥門卡滯，可能在溫度變化時產生不應有的大力，使塔或支承受額外彎矩；反之若鎖定失效，颱風陣風使橋面縱向往復移動，加速伸縮縫與支承磨耗。~Leaking seals or a stuck valve can generate large unintended forces during temperature change, adding moment to the tower or bearings; conversely, failed lock-up lets typhoon gusts shuttle the deck longitudinally, accelerating joint and bearing wear.
units.misconception: 塔梁之間只要用固定支承鎖死，橋就最穩。~Fixing the deck rigidly to the tower always makes the bridge most stable.
units.practice: 維護手冊應規定緩衝器的檢查頻率、漏油判定、行程刻度讀數與颱風後的專項檢查；更換緩衝器時須有臨時縱向約束方案與交通管制。~The maintenance manual should set buffer inspection frequency, leak criteria, stroke-scale readings and post-typhoon special checks; buffer replacement needs a temporary longitudinal restraint scheme and traffic management.

units.anchor: 雙相不鏽鋼外皮~Duplex stainless skin
units.title: 不鏽鋼複合上塔與單柱塔斷面~Composite stainless upper tower and monopole section
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋的塔為中空單柱，斷面由下方的橢圓形逐漸收成上方的圓形，塔頂達主水平基準以上約 298 m。約 +175 m 以下為鋼筋混凝土，以上改為鋼—混凝土複合段，外層是雙相不鏽鋼板，不只是飾面，而是與內部混凝土共同受力的結構元件。斜索錨固集中在上塔，需要高勁度與高強度；不鏽鋼外皮同時省去日後高空重新塗裝，降低維護成本與風險。複合段設計重點在剪力釘或連接件把鋼皮與混凝土結合，避免溫差與乾縮使兩者分離。~The Stonecutters towers are hollow monopoles whose section tapers from an ellipse below to a circle above, reaching about +298 mPD. Below about +175 m they are reinforced concrete; above, a steel–concrete composite section with a duplex stainless steel outer skin that is a structural element acting with the concrete, not cladding. Stay anchorages concentrate in the upper tower and need high stiffness and strength, and the stainless skin avoids repainting at height, reducing maintenance cost and risk. The composite design hinges on studs or connectors that bond skin and concrete so temperature differences and shrinkage do not separate them.
units.model: 換算斷面軸向勁度 EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s。取周長 30 m、外皮 20 mm，A_s = 0.6 m²；混凝土 A_c = 18 m²，E_c = 40 GPa、E_s = 200 GPa：E_c·A_c = 720 GN，E_s·A_s = 120 GN，外皮貢獻 120/840 ≈ 14% 的軸向勁度。尺寸為教學假設。~Transformed axial stiffness EA = E_c·A_c + E_s·A_s. With a 30 m perimeter and 20 mm skin, A_s = 0.6 m²; with A_c = 18 m², E_c = 40 GPa and E_s = 200 GPa, E_c·A_c = 720 GN and E_s·A_s = 120 GN, so the skin supplies 120/840 ≈ 14% of the axial stiffness. Dimensions are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋼皮分段在工廠製作時量測真圓度與焊接變形，現場吊裝後以測量確認軸線；剪力連接件做抽樣拉拔或彎曲試驗，混凝土灌注後以敲擊或超音波檢查鋼皮與混凝土是否脫空。~Measure roundness and weld distortion of skin segments in the shop and survey the axis after erection; proof-test sample shear connectors by pull-out or bend tests, and after concreting check for voids between skin and concrete by tapping or ultrasonic testing.
units.failure: 若鋼皮與混凝土間灌漿不密實或連接件不足，鋼皮在日照溫差下局部鼓起，複合作用消失，錨固區的應力集中提高；不同金屬接觸處若未隔離，也可能出現電化學腐蝕。~Incomplete concrete fill or too few connectors lets the skin bulge locally under solar temperature differences, losing composite action and raising stress concentrations in the anchorage zone; contact between dissimilar metals without isolation can also cause galvanic corrosion.
units.misconception: 不鏽鋼外皮只是為了外觀好看，不參與結構受力。~The stainless skin is only for appearance and carries no structural load.
units.practice: 複合塔段的施工計畫要規定每節鋼皮的定位公差、混凝土分層澆置高度與側壓限制，以及脫空檢測的抽樣比例；不同金屬接觸點的絕緣細部須在圖上標示。~The composite-tower method statement should set positioning tolerances for each skin segment, concrete lift heights and lateral-pressure limits, and the sampling rate for void detection; insulation details at dissimilar-metal contacts must be shown on the drawings.

units.title: 224 根斜拉索、錨箱與索徑配置~The 224 stays, anchor boxes and cable sizes
units.mechanism: 全橋 224 根斜拉索以雙索面修正扇形配置，主跨錨距約 18 m、背跨約 10 m，最長約 540 m、單根約 70 t，全部斜索合計約 7,200 t。公開設計資料顯示索的外徑由塔附近的 113 mm（163 根鋼線）增到背跨端的 192 mm（499 根鋼線），因為越靠背跨端的背索要平衡越多主跨重量。上塔內約 1,200 t 的鋼錨箱把各索的集中力分散到塔壁，同時讓張拉設備有作業空間。索徑與鋼線數的變化正好反映了扇形配置下索力的分布。~The bridge has 224 stays in two planes in a modified fan, anchored at about 18 m spacing in the main span and about 10 m in the back spans; the longest is about 540 m and about 70 t, and all stays total about 7,200 t. Published design data show outside diameters rising from 113 mm (163 wires) near the towers to 192 mm (499 wires) toward the back-span ends, because the back stays nearest the ends balance the most main-span weight. Steel anchor boxes of about 1,200 t in the upper towers spread each concentrated stay force into the tower walls and give room for stressing equipment. The change of diameter and wire count mirrors the force distribution in a fan arrangement.
units.model: 假設鋼線直徑 7 mm、抗拉強度 1,770 MPa：499 根 A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm²，破斷力約 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN，0.45 倍約 15,300 kN；163 根 A ≈ 6,270 mm²，破斷力約 11,100 kN。最長索 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m。鋼線直徑與強度為教學假設。~Assuming 7 mm wires of 1,770 MPa: 499 wires give A = 499×38.48 ≈ 19,200 mm² and a breaking force of about 19,200×1,770 ≈ 34,000 kN, with 0.45 of that about 15,300 kN; 163 wires give A ≈ 6,270 mm² and about 11,100 kN. The longest stay averages 70 t/540 m ≈ 130 kg/m. Wire size and strength are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 斜索與錨具依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞、破斷與防水試驗，並在 1:1 索段做風雨振試驗；錨箱焊道以超音波檢測，安裝後量測每根索的最終力與錨頭位置，與設計表逐一比對。~Test stay and anchorage assemblies for fatigue, ultimate strength and watertightness under stay-cable recommendations, and test full-scale cable sections for wind and rain vibration; inspect anchor-box welds ultrasonically and after installation compare each stay’s final force and anchor-head position with the design table.
units.failure: 錨箱焊道或承壓板細節不當時，反覆的索力變化會在焊趾處產生疲勞裂縫；錨頭防水失效則讓水進入索內，鋼線在錨口附近腐蝕，這個位置正是目視最難檢查的地方。~Poor anchor-box welds or bearing-plate details let repeated force changes start fatigue cracks at weld toes; failed anchor-head sealing lets water into the cable and corrodes wires near the socket, exactly where visual inspection is hardest.
units.misconception: 同一座橋的斜拉索應該都一樣粗，才方便施工和維護。~All stays on one bridge should have the same size for easier construction and maintenance.
units.practice: 交接時要留下每根索的編號、鋼線數、外徑、設計與實測索力、錨具型號及出廠試驗報告；錨箱內要設照明、通風與檢查通道，確保日後能接近錨頭。~At handover keep each stay’s number, wire count, diameter, design and measured force, anchorage type and test reports; anchor boxes need lighting, ventilation and access so anchor heads can be reached later.

units.anchor: 起重門架與最大懸臂~Lifting gantries and maximum cantilever
units.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與颱風季臨時穩定~Cantilever lifting of steel boxes and typhoon-season stability
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋主跨鋼梁在工廠分片製造、再組成節段，以駁船運到橋下，由懸臂端的起重門架垂直吊升，逐段焊接並安裝對應的斜索；靠近塔的一小段鋼梁則在臨時支架上架設。懸臂越伸越長時，結構是兩支各約 500 m 的懸臂，橫向只有塔與斜索支撐，對颱風最為脆弱；吊裝作業又受海峽航運與潮流限制。施工團隊必須規劃颱風來臨前的停工、門架固定與臨時抗風措施，並預估懸臂端在風中的位移與塔底的附加彎矩。~The main-span steel was fabricated as panels, assembled into segments, barged under the bridge and lifted vertically by gantries at the cantilever tips, each segment welded in and its stays installed; the short section next to each tower was erected on temporary falsework. As the cantilevers grow, the structure becomes two cantilevers of roughly 500 m supported laterally only by the tower and stays, its most typhoon-vulnerable state, while lifts are also constrained by channel shipping and currents. The team must plan stoppages, gantry tie-downs and temporary wind measures before a typhoon and predict cantilever-tip displacement and the added moment at the tower base.
units.model: 懸臂受均布側風 w 時，塔處側向彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取 w = 4.9 kN/m、L = 500 m：M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m；若施工期設計風速使 w 降為 3.9 kN/m，M ≈ 490,000 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~For a cantilever under uniform side wind w, the lateral moment at the tower is M = w·L²/2. With w = 4.9 kN/m and L = 500 m, M = 4.9×500²/2 ≈ 612,500 kN·m; if the construction-stage design wind reduces w to 3.9 kN/m, M ≈ 490,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工階段分析逐一檢查每個懸臂長度下的抗風安全與顫振臨界風速，並在現場設風速計與懸臂端 GNSS；每次吊裝前確認風速、潮流與航道封閉，門架與吊具由第三方檢驗，吊裝後量測節段高程與斜索力。~The staged analysis checks wind safety and flutter speed at each cantilever length, with anemometers and GNSS at the tip on site; before each lift confirm wind, current and channel closure, have gantries and rigging third-party inspected, and after the lift measure segment levels and stay forces.
units.failure: 颱風預警時若懸臂端門架或未焊完的節段沒有可靠固定，強風可能使吊具擺動撞擊結構；最大懸臂狀態下若臨時抗風措施不足，側向位移與塔底彎矩可能超出設計，甚至出現施工期的氣彈振動。~If gantries or partly welded segments at the tip are not secured when a typhoon warning is issued, rigging can swing into the structure; at the maximum cantilever, inadequate temporary wind measures can push lateral displacement and tower-base moment beyond design or even trigger construction-stage aeroelastic motion.
units.misconception: 成橋狀態能抗颱風，施工中的懸臂狀態自然也能。~If the completed bridge resists typhoons, the cantilever stage naturally does too.
units.practice: 施工計畫要訂出各懸臂長度的作業風速上限、颱風警報分級對應的固定程序與人員撤離時點，並把最大懸臂的抗風措施列為停留檢查點，由設計與施工工程師共同確認。~The method statement should set working wind limits for each cantilever length, securing procedures and evacuation times for each typhoon-signal level, with the maximum-cantilever wind measures a hold point confirmed jointly by the design and construction engineers.

units.anchor: 背跨鋼混接頭~Back-span steel–concrete junction
units.title: 鋼—混凝土接合段的力量傳遞~Force transfer at the steel–concrete junction
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋的鋼主梁並不在塔處結束，而是伸入背跨約 49.75 m 後才與混凝土雙箱梁接合。接頭位置選在彎矩與剪力相對溫和處，但仍要傳遞斜索在橋面累積的巨大水平壓力、彎矩與剪力。常見做法是在鋼梁端部設承壓板與格室，內部填混凝土，以剪力釘、開孔鋼板連接件與預力鋼腱把鋼與混凝土綁成一體。接頭兩側勁度差異很大，溫度、乾縮與徐變都會在界面集中應力，因此是全橋細部最複雜的區域之一。~The Stonecutters steel girder does not stop at the towers; it extends about 49.75 m into each back span before joining the concrete twin boxes. The junction is placed where moment and shear are relatively moderate but must still transfer the large horizontal compression accumulated from the stays, plus moment and shear. A common solution uses end bearing plates and cells filled with concrete, with shear studs, perforated-plate connectors and prestressing tendons binding steel and concrete together. Stiffness changes sharply across the junction, and temperature, shrinkage and creep concentrate stress at the interface, making it one of the most complex details of the bridge.
units.model: 若接頭需傳遞 100 MN 的水平壓力，其中由剪力釘承擔的部分以每支 150 kN 的設計強度計，需約 100,000/150 ≈ 667 支；若改由承壓板直接承擔一半，剪力釘只需約 334 支。力量與釘強度為教學假設。~If the junction must transfer 100 MN of horizontal compression and studs carry it at 150 kN design resistance each, about 100,000/150 ≈ 667 studs are needed; if bearing plates take half directly, only about 334 studs are needed. Force and stud resistance are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以局部有限元素模型分析承壓板、格室與連接件的應力分布，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證荷重—滑移行為；現場檢查剪力釘焊接（彎曲試驗）、格室混凝土密實度與預力鋼腱的伸長量紀錄。~Analyse bearing plates, cells and connectors with a local finite-element model and verify load–slip behaviour on scaled or full-size specimens; on site check stud welds by bend testing, concrete compaction in the cells and elongation records of the tendons.
units.failure: 格室混凝土不密實或剪力釘焊接不良，會讓接頭出現界面滑移與裂縫，水分沿界面滲入造成鋼材與鋼筋腐蝕；長期徐變重分配若未納入設計，接頭附近的混凝土可能開裂，鋼梁端部出現疲勞熱點。~Poorly compacted cell concrete or bad stud welds let the interface slip and crack, admitting water that corrodes steel and reinforcement; if long-term creep redistribution is not designed for, concrete near the junction can crack and fatigue hot spots appear at the steel ends.
units.misconception: 鋼梁與混凝土梁只要用螺栓頭對頭接上，力量就會平均傳遞。~Bolting the steel girder end to the concrete girder end transfers force evenly.
units.practice: 接頭格室的混凝土澆置要有排氣孔與觀察孔，並以試拌與模擬澆置確認流動性；施工紀錄要保存剪力釘檢測與預力張拉資料，作為日後評估接頭狀態的依據。~Cells at the junction need vent and inspection holes, with flowability proven by trial mixes and mock-up pours; keep stud-test and tendon-stressing records as the basis for later condition assessment of the junction.

units.title: 多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形~Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain
units.mechanism: 公開設計資料指出，昂船洲大橋做了 1:80 與 1:20 兩種比例的橋面斷面風洞試驗、1:1 的斜索試驗以及 1:1,500 的地形模型試驗。原因在於風洞模型無法同時滿足所有相似律：小比例模型的雷諾數比實橋小數百倍，流線形箱梁圓角處的分離點可能與實橋不同，使渦振與氣動係數失真；較大的 1:20 模型提高雷諾數以檢核這種敏感性。地形模型則用來取得周邊山體與城市對來風的紊流與風速剖面，作為斷面試驗的輸入。~Published design data state that Stonecutters Bridge was tested with deck section models at 1:80 and 1:20, full-scale 1:1 stay tests and a 1:1,500 terrain model. No wind-tunnel model can satisfy every similarity law: a small model’s Reynolds number is hundreds of times below full scale, so flow separation at the rounded corners of a streamlined box may differ from reality and distort vortex response and aerodynamic coefficients; the larger 1:20 model raises the Reynolds number to check this sensitivity. The terrain model provides turbulence and wind profiles from the surrounding hills and city as input to the section tests.
units.model: 雷諾數 Re = U·D/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。1:80 模型 D = 0.05 m、U = 10 m/s：Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴；實橋 D = 4 m、U = 50 m/s：Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷，相差約 400 倍；1:20 模型 D = 0.2 m、U = 10 m/s 時 Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵，差距縮小到約 100 倍。尺寸與風速為教學假設。~Reynolds number Re = U·D/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s. A 1:80 model with D = 0.05 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 3.3×10⁴; the bridge with D = 4 m at 50 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁷, about 400 times higher; a 1:20 model with D = 0.2 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.3×10⁵, narrowing the gap to about 100 times. Dimensions and speeds are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較兩種比例模型在相同折算風速下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，若差異顯著，以較大比例或表面粗糙化處理推估實橋行為；地形模型量測的紊流強度與積分尺度要與現場風速計長期資料互相校核。~Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes of the two model scales at the same reduced velocity; where they differ significantly, infer full-scale behaviour from the larger scale or with surface roughening; cross-check turbulence intensity and integral scales from the terrain model against long-term site anemometer data.
units.failure: 若只依小比例模型認定沒有渦振，實橋在較高雷諾數下的分離行為改變，可能出現模型未預測的振動；反之也可能因模型過度保守而增加不必要的導流板或阻尼裝置。~Relying on a small model alone to rule out vortex vibration can miss oscillation that appears at full-scale Reynolds numbers where separation changes; the opposite error adds unnecessary fairings or dampers because the model was over-conservative.
units.misconception: 風洞模型只要幾何縮尺正確，試驗結果就能直接放大套用到實橋。~If a wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its results scale directly to the full bridge.
units.practice: 風洞試驗規範應寫明模型比例、相似律取捨、雷諾數敏感性檢核與附屬物細節；通車後安排實橋風速與加速度監測，回饋驗證試驗推估。~The wind-testing specification should state model scales, which similarity laws are relaxed, Reynolds-sensitivity checks and attachment details; after opening, arrange full-scale wind and acceleration monitoring to validate the test predictions.

units.anchor: 跨中 GNSS 測點~Mid-span GNSS stations
units.title: 跨中撓度與結構健康監測判讀~Mid-span deflection and health-monitoring interpretation
units.mechanism: 香港路政署公開資料指出，昂船洲大橋跨中在交通荷載下撓度可達約 1.8 m，在風荷載下可達約 2.2 m。這樣大的位移是千米跨斜張橋的正常行為，而非缺陷，但也代表伸縮縫、支承、緩衝器與路面都必須容許相應的變形。監測系統以 GNSS、加速度計、應變計、溫度計與風速計記錄橋梁反應，工程師要把實測撓度依溫度、交通與風況分類，才能和設計預測公平比較，並從長期趨勢找出支承卡滯、索力變化或基礎沉陷的徵兆。~Hong Kong Highways Department data state that Stonecutters Bridge can deflect about 1.8 m at mid-span under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind. Such movements are normal for a 1 km cable-stayed span, not defects, but they require joints, bearings, buffers and surfacing to accommodate them. The monitoring system records response with GNSS, accelerometers, strain gauges, thermometers and anemometers, and engineers must sort measured deflections by temperature, traffic and wind before comparing them fairly with predictions, then look for signs of seized bearings, stay-force change or foundation settlement in long-term trends.
units.model: 撓跨比：交通 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566，風 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463。若 GNSS 定位精度 ±15 mm，相對交通撓度的量測誤差約 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%，足以追蹤 5% 量級的勁度變化。精度為教學假設，撓度為公開資料。~Deflection-to-span ratios are 1.8/1,018 ≈ 1/566 for traffic and 2.2/1,018 ≈ 1/463 for wind. With ±15 mm GNSS precision, the error relative to the traffic deflection is about 15/1,800 ≈ 0.8%, enough to track stiffness changes of the order of 5%. The precision is a teaching assumption; the deflections are published values.
units.verify: 以動態地磅或交通攝影辨識重車事件，計算單位車重的撓度影響線並與模型比較；以颱風事件資料比對風速—撓度曲線；感測器每年校正，GNSS 基準站設在穩定地點，並與精密水準定期比對。~Identify heavy-vehicle events with weigh-in-motion or traffic cameras, compute deflection influence lines per unit vehicle weight and compare with the model; compare wind speed–deflection curves from typhoon records; calibrate sensors yearly, place the GNSS reference station on stable ground and cross-check periodically with precise levelling.
units.failure: 若把颱風或高溫時的大撓度誤判為結構劣化，可能做出不必要的封橋決策；反之若未做溫度與交通分類，真正的勁度下降可能隱藏在日常變動中，直到伸縮縫行程不足才被發現。~Misreading large typhoon or hot-weather deflections as deterioration can trigger unnecessary closures; without temperature and traffic sorting, a genuine stiffness loss can hide in daily variation until joint travel runs out.
units.misconception: 大橋跨中撓度達到一兩公尺，就表示結構不安全。~A mid-span deflection of one or two metres means the bridge is unsafe.
units.practice: 監測報告要以「荷載分類後的殘差趨勢」呈現，而不是原始讀數；警戒值應依設計預測加上量測不確定度設定，並寫明超限時的通報對象與現場複核程序。~Monitoring reports should present residual trends after load classification, not raw readings; alert levels should be set from design predictions plus measurement uncertainty, stating who is notified and how field verification proceeds when exceeded.

units.anchor: 下塔不鏽鋼鋼筋~Stainless reinforcement in the lower tower
units.title: 海洋環境下塔與基礎的耐久設計~Durability of lower towers and foundations in a marine setting
units.mechanism: 昂船洲大橋下塔位於海水飛濺與潮汐乾濕交替區，氯離子是鋼筋腐蝕的主要驅動力。公開資料指出下塔為使用不鏽鋼鋼筋的鋼筋混凝土，基礎為擴底鑽掘樁，岩盤深度約在 −40 m 至 −90 m 之間，並考慮負摩擦力。氯離子由表面向內擴散，到達鋼筋位置且濃度超過臨界值後，碳鋼鋼筋開始腐蝕並膨脹剝落；不鏽鋼鋼筋的臨界氯離子濃度高得多，可大幅延後腐蝕起始，適合用在最難維修的高風險區。~The Stonecutters lower towers sit in the seawater splash and tidal zone, where chloride drives reinforcement corrosion. Published data state the lower towers are reinforced concrete with stainless steel bars, and the foundations are bored piles with enlarged bases, with bedrock at roughly −40 m to −90 m and negative skin friction considered. Chlorides diffuse inward from the surface, and once they reach the bars above a threshold, carbon-steel bars start corroding, expand and spall the cover; stainless bars tolerate a much higher chloride threshold, greatly delaying corrosion onset, which suits the highest-risk zones that are hardest to repair.
units.model: 氯離子前緣深度約 x ≈ 2√(D·t)。取 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 120 年（約 3.79×10⁹ s）：x ≈ 2√(3.79×10⁻³) ≈ 0.123 m；若以低滲透混凝土使 D = 3×10⁻¹³ m²/s，x ≈ 0.067 m。前者已超過 75 mm 保護層，說明需搭配不鏽鋼鋼筋或更低滲透率。數值為教學假設。~The chloride front depth is roughly x ≈ 2√(D·t). With D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s and t = 120 years (about 3.79×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2√(3.79×10⁻³) ≈ 0.123 m; a low-permeability concrete with D = 3×10⁻¹³ m²/s gives x ≈ 0.067 m. The first exceeds a 75 mm cover, showing the need for stainless bars or lower permeability. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工時以試體量測氯離子擴散係數與保護層厚度（鋼筋掃描儀），營運期定期鑽取粉末或岩心量測氯離子剖面，擬合表面濃度與擴散係數，推估腐蝕起始時間；基礎則以沉陷監測與水下檢查確認。~During construction measure chloride diffusion on specimens and cover with a covermeter; in service periodically sample dust or cores for chloride profiles, fit surface concentration and diffusion coefficient and project corrosion onset; check foundations with settlement monitoring and underwater inspection.
units.failure: 飛濺區保護層不足或混凝土蜂窩，會讓氯離子提早到達鋼筋，造成鏽脹裂縫與剝落；若不同材質鋼筋混用而未隔離，接觸處也可能加速碳鋼腐蝕。~Insufficient cover or honeycombing in the splash zone lets chlorides reach the bars early, causing rust cracking and spalling; mixing reinforcement types without isolation can accelerate carbon-steel corrosion at contacts.
units.misconception: 只要混凝土強度高，海水環境下就不會有鋼筋腐蝕問題。~High-strength concrete alone prevents reinforcement corrosion in seawater.
units.practice: 耐久設計報告要依暴露分區列出保護層、混凝土配比、鋼筋材質與設計年限內的腐蝕起始推估，並在交接時提供監測取樣位置圖，使後續量測能在相同位置重複比較。~The durability report should list cover, mix, bar type and projected corrosion onset within the design life for each exposure zone, and handover should include a sampling-location map so later measurements repeat at the same spots.

units.anchor: 540 m 最長索~The 540 m longest stay
units.title: 長索頻率、索力追蹤與維護交接~Long-stay frequency, force tracking and handover
units.mechanism: 最長約 540 m 的斜拉索質量大、垂度明顯，第一振動頻率只有零點幾赫茲，容易受風雨激振，也不易以千斤頂直接量測索力。營運期最實用的方法是以加速度計量測索的自然頻率，再以張緊弦公式換算索力，長索需另行修正垂度與彎曲勁度的影響。定期比對索力趨勢可以發現錨具滑移、鋼線斷絲或阻尼器失效；交接文件則要把每根索的基準頻率、溫度與量測方法完整保存，讓下一代維護工程師能重複同樣的量測。~The longest stay, about 540 m, is heavy and sags noticeably, with a first natural frequency of only a few tenths of a hertz; it is prone to wind–rain excitation and hard to measure directly with jacks. The most practical in-service method measures the natural frequency with an accelerometer and converts it to force with the taut-string formula, with corrections for sag and bending stiffness on long stays. Comparing force trends over time reveals anchor slip, broken wires or damper failure, and the handover file must preserve each stay’s baseline frequency, temperature and method so the next generation of engineers can repeat the measurement.
units.model: 張緊弦 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取 L = 540 m、m = 70,000/540 ≈ 129.6 kg/m、T = 9,000 kN：√(9×10⁶/129.6) ≈ 263.5 m/s，f₁ ≈ 263.5/1,080 ≈ 0.244 Hz；若索力降 10%，f₁ 只降到約 0.231 Hz（√0.9 ≈ 0.949），量測需要足夠的頻率解析度。索力為教學假設。~Taut string f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 540 m, m = 70,000/540 ≈ 129.6 kg/m and T = 9,000 kN, √(9×10⁶/129.6) ≈ 263.5 m/s and f₁ ≈ 263.5/1,080 ≈ 0.244 Hz; a 10% force loss lowers f₁ only to about 0.231 Hz (√0.9 ≈ 0.949), so adequate frequency resolution is essential. The force is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每根索以至少約 10 分鐘的環境振動紀錄取得多階頻率，以高階頻率比值檢查垂度與彎曲勁度修正，再與施工完成時以千斤頂或荷重計標定的索力比較；量測同時記錄索溫與氣溫。~Record at least about 10 minutes of ambient vibration per stay to obtain several modal frequencies, use ratios of higher modes to check sag and bending corrections, and compare with forces calibrated by jacks or load cells at completion; record cable and air temperature simultaneously.
units.failure: 只用第一頻率而不修正垂度，長索索力可能被高估或低估數個百分點，使真正的錨具滑移被誤判；量測時段若遇陣風或交通激振，頻譜出現交雜峰值，也會造成錯誤判讀。~Using only the first frequency without sag correction can mis-estimate long-stay force by several percent and mask real anchor slip; gusts or traffic excitation during the record add confusing spectral peaks and lead to misreading.
units.misconception: 斜拉索索力一旦施工完成就不會再改變，不需要追蹤。~Stay forces never change after construction, so they need no tracking.
units.practice: 交接資料應包含每根索的基準頻率表、計算參數（長度、單位質量、垂度修正）、量測位置與照片；維護單位每次量測都要沿用相同程序，差異超過警戒時先複測再啟動調查。~Handover data should include a baseline frequency table for every stay, calculation parameters (length, mass per metre, sag correction), measurement locations and photographs; the maintainer must follow the same procedure each time and repeat a measurement before launching an investigation when a deviation exceeds the alert level.

example: 設計練習：估算颱風時主跨跨中的側向變形量級。取橋面側風荷載 w = 4.9 kN/m（U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8、D = 4 m），主跨 L = 1,018 m。若把主跨視為兩端由塔約束、中間由斜索提供有限側向勁度的梁，以簡支梁上限估計 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI)：取兩箱合計側向 EI = 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m²，L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹²，δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m。公開資料中風荷載跨中撓度約 2.2 m，比簡支上限小，表示斜索的擺錘效應與塔的約束分擔了約 35% 的側向變形（1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35）。若風速降為 40 m/s，w 與 δ 都乘以 (40/50)² = 0.64。EI 與係數為教學假設，非本橋設計值。~Design exercise: estimate the order of mid-span lateral movement in a typhoon. Take a side wind load w = 4.9 kN/m (U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8, D = 4 m) on the L = 1,018 m main span. Treating the main span as a beam restrained by the towers with limited lateral stiffness from the stays, an upper bound from a simply supported beam is δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI); with a combined lateral EI of 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m² for the two boxes and L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹², δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m. The published wind deflection of about 2.2 m is smaller, implying that the pendulum action of the stays and tower restraint remove about 35% of the lateral movement (1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35). At 40 m/s both w and δ scale by (40/50)² = 0.64. EI and coefficients are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.
history: 香港政府為 8 號幹線跨越藍巴勒海峽，於 2000 年舉辦國際設計比賽，之後由 Arup 主導、COWI 為分包顧問的團隊承擔細部設計，2002 年展開細部設計。主體工程由前田建設、日立造船、橫河橋梁與新昌營造組成的聯營承造，2004 年 4 月開工，約 68 個月後於 2009 年 12 月通車，當時是全球僅有的兩座主跨超過 1,000 m 的斜張橋之一。其分離式雙箱梁、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與塔梁液壓緩衝器，是颱風區超大跨斜張橋的代表性解法。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~To carry Route 8 over the Rambler Channel, the Hong Kong Government held an international design competition in 2000; an Arup-led team with COWI as subconsultant then took on the detailed design, which began in 2002. A joint venture of Maeda, Hitachi Zosen, Yokogawa Bridge and Hsin Chong built the bridge from April 2004, and it opened in December 2009 after about 68 months, one of only two cable-stayed bridges in the world with a span over 1,000 m at the time. Its split twin-box deck, composite stainless monopole towers and tower–deck hydraulic buffers are a reference solution for very long cable-stayed spans in typhoon regions. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 主跨 1,018 m，兩側背跨各 289 m，全長 1,596 m~Main span 1,018 m with two 289 m back spans; overall length 1,596 m
塔頂高程達主水平基準以上約 298 m，約 +175 m 以下為混凝土~The towers reach about +298 mPD, with concrete up to about +175 mPD
橋面約 53 m 寬，主跨鋼箱梁約 33,500 t~The deck is about 53 m wide, and the main-span steel deck weighs about 33,500 t
共 224 根斜拉索，最長約 540 m，斜索合計約 7,200 t~There are 224 stays, the longest about 540 m, totalling about 7,200 t
跨中撓度：交通荷載約 1.8 m、風荷載約 2.2 m~Mid-span deflection is about 1.8 m under traffic and about 2.2 m under wind
最小通航淨空約 73.5 m~Minimum navigation headroom is about 73.5 m
零攻角無車時顫振臨界風速約 95 m/s，±5° 攻角時約 50 m/s~Flutter speed is about 95 m/s at zero incidence without traffic and about 50 m/s at ±5°
主體合約約港幣 27.6 億元，2004 年 4 月開工、2009 年 12 月通車~The main contract was about HK$2.76 billion, starting April 2004 and opening December 2009
全橋混凝土約 136,000 m³，不鏽鋼約 1,100 t~The bridge used about 136,000 m³ of concrete and about 1,100 t of stainless steel

timeline.event: 香港政府舉辦昂船洲大橋國際設計比賽~The Hong Kong Government holds the Stonecutters Bridge international design competition
Arup 與 COWI 團隊展開細部設計，完成多尺度風洞試驗~Arup and COWI begin detailed design, including multi-scale wind-tunnel testing
4 月主體工程開工，由前田、日立造船、橫河橋梁與新昌聯營承造~Main works start in April under the Maeda, Hitachi Zosen, Yokogawa Bridge and Hsin Chong joint venture
12 月通車，成為當時全球兩座主跨逾千米斜張橋之一~The bridge opens in December as one of two cable-stayed bridges with spans over 1,000 m
獲英國結構工程師學會結構獎與日本土木學會田中賞~Wins an IStructE Structural Award and the JSCE Tanaka Award

sources.title: 香港路政署：昂船洲大橋資料單張
sources.titleEn: Hong Kong Highways Department: Stonecutters Bridge fact sheet
sources.scope: 業主公開的跨徑、塔高、斜索數量與重量、鋼與混凝土用量、跨中撓度、合約金額與通車時間。
sources.scopeEn: Owner fact sheet with spans, tower height, stay count and weight, steel and concrete quantities, mid-span deflections, contract value and opening date.

sources.title: AFGC 研討會論文：昂船洲大橋設計
sources.titleEn: AFGC conference paper: design of Stonecutters Bridge
sources.scope: 設計工程師論文，含背跨分跨、橋面斷面、斜索外徑與鋼線數、顫振臨界風速、風洞比例、基礎與架設方法。
sources.scopeEn: Design engineers’ paper with back-span layout, deck section, stay diameters and wire counts, flutter speeds, wind-tunnel scales, foundations and erection methods.

sources.title: 英國結構工程師學會：2010 年結構獎昂船洲大橋
sources.scope: 工程學會得獎說明，描述分離雙箱梁、雙相不鏽鋼複合塔、背跨現澆與設計團隊分工。
sources.scopeEn: Institution award citation describing the split twin-box deck, duplex stainless composite towers, cast-in-place back spans and design-team roles.

sources.title: 日本土木學會田中賞：昂船洲大橋
sources.scope: 學會得獎頁，列出聯營承造商、塔斷面與材料，以及塔梁間液壓緩衝器的功能。
sources.scopeEn: Society award page listing the joint-venture contractors, tower section and materials, and the function of the tower–deck hydraulic buffers.
